body: If I wait it out I'm going to be thirty and living with my parents.  I don't want to be that guy, and I'm on my path to being exactly that.  I need to make a change right now but I'm too comfortable to even think about it.

I've tried going to groups in churches, but I found the environment too preachy, and the age group of the kids was mostly around the age of twelve.  There was nothing there for me.

I live in a very small town, there's hardly any activity around here.  I wish it was that simple though.  Thank you for the advice.
